text: {"label":"Toilet Training and Bathroom Hygiene","definition":"Behavior-analytic procedures for teaching urinary and bowel continence, self-initiated toileting, and related hygiene skills such as wiping and handwashing, often with children with autism and caregiver or practitioner implementation.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Targets continence and bathroom self-care skills, not habit behaviors like nail biting or skin picking, general early-intervention care and rapport, or compliance with instructions."}
